_comment: Which standard gamepad element drives each ares button, per console.
The left side is ares' own button name inside
<Console>/Input/Controller.Port.N/Gamepad; the right side is SDL's name for
a standard element, which SDL maps to whatever raw index a given controller
actually uses. That indirection is the point: the same table works for a
pad whose A is button 0 and one whose A is button 1.
Only consoles confirmed against a real settings.bml are listed. An ares
console section is created the first time that console is run, so the name
cannot be guessed from the platform slug — add one by playing the console
once and reading the section heading.
